confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or July 2026 prices. Food and coffee anchors are moderate confidence. Alcohol is lower confidence: cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (about 2x and 2.3x the beer anchor) because direct knowledge of ordinary-venue prices is weak. Hostel and hotel ranges are broad. USD values assume roughly IDR 16,000–17,000 per USD and include typical tax and service. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries of RBA exchange-rate pages, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: large Southeast Asian capitals. Food and coffee are set near local rupiah-priced dining levels; alcohol is set high relative to food because of Indonesian excise and import duties; hostel and hotel tiers follow central Jakarta budget and business-hotel stock. No single named comparable city was used.
